verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party way to operate the Together AI platform itself (deploying endpoints, launching fine-tunes, managing batches) through natural-language commands. The agent skills teach a third-party coding agent to write Together code, and the docs MCP server only offers documentation lookup. Both are adjacent building blocks that rely on the user's own agent, and chat inference on hosted models is the product's service rather than a way to control the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
